curriculum_expectations.B1.1: read, represent, compose, and decompose whole numbers up to and including 200, using a variety of tools and strategies, and describe various ways they are used in everyday life
curriculum_expectations.B1.2: compare and order whole numbers up to and including 200, in various contexts
curriculum_expectations.B1.3: estimate the number of objects in collections of up to 200 and verify their estimates by counting
curriculum_expectations.B1.4: count to 200, including by 20s, 25s, and 50s, using a variety of tools and strategies
curriculum_expectations.B1.5: describe what makes a number even or odd
curriculum_expectations.B1.6: use drawings to represent, solve, and compare the results of fair-share problems that involve sharing up to 10 items among 2, 3, 4, and 6 sharers, including problems that result in whole numbers, mixed numbers, and fractional amounts
curriculum_expectations.B1.7: recognize that one third and two sixths of the same whole are equal, in fair-sharing contexts
